text_block_list.text:
June. As early summer drew to a close and 
the heat grew stifling, one day after 
training...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Would you like a refill on your 
iced coffee?
choice_data_list: Thanks. But maybe not right now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Mmhmm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Those documents! Are you putting them 
on the shelf? Let me do it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Not at all, leave it to me!

...She's been like this for the past few 
days. Even after training ends, she stays 
in the Trainer's Room, looking for any 
excuse to help out...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Alright, all do~ne!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ummm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Is there anything elseâ

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

Seeing her completely blank expression, I 
thought. Her behavior was clearly bizarre. 
Trying to fathom her intentions—
choice_data_list:
...That new pancake place in front of the 
station?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, huh!? I-It's nothing like that~!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Auugh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes, actually~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um, pulling ourselves together... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Could I take just a short break from 
entering races...!?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no, no, no! I'm not sick or 
injured or anything like that, not at 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry for being so confusing. Well, 
um...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I just have to!! I really, really want to 
go watch Sweep-san's race...!

Hearing that, it suddenly hits me. 
Speaking of the next race for Sweep Tosho, 
the one Line Craft absolutely idolizes—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's right, the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san said so! That in this Grand 
Prix, she'll clash with the Triple Crown 
route Umamusume, and win—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Overturning boring common sense! Using 
that kind of 'racing magic'!
choice_data_list:
That's... definitely something we can't 
overlook.

That's... definitely not something we can 
miss.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Do you understand me!?!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Th-Then—!
choice_data_list:
Sure. Let's take a break from racing for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I did it...!! Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...! Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer gave us permission. Hehe... 
aren't you glad, Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Oh man, oh man, I'm so excited I 
don't think I can even sleep tonight~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I know! Why don't you come along 
too, Cesario?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go! I'm sure it's gonna be an 
amazing race—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'm not going. ...I can't go.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's a very important errand.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't go to the 'Takarazuka Kinen'. 
I'm leaving Japan in a few days, and I 
won't be back for about a month."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I—will run in an American GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!? A-... America!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-What the... huh!? What do you mean, 
Cesario...!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Let's head back to the room, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There is something I want to talk to you 
about.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
C-Cesario! Um, so, about what we were 
talking about earlier—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: You're running in an American GⅠ...?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Craft, do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You and me. That very first night we spent 
in the same dorm room.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh... F-First?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The night of the first day... if I 
remember correctly—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You were itching to race, weren't you, 
Craft? After the entrance ceremony... 
during the first homeroom 
self-introductions, when I said I was 
aiming for the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"You said you'd wanted to talk about that 
forever and ever. We talked about the 
Triple Tiara races you love, the senpai 
you look up to, the dreams you hold... 
didn't we?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I got carried away too, completely 
forgetting to go eat dinner because we 
were having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The dorm cafeteria was closed... So we 
asked the dorm leader, Fuji-san, to let us 
use the kitchen, and made a midnight snack 
together, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We talked again after that, didn't we? 
About all your feelings for the Tiara 
route...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I remember too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I was really happy. It was so 
encouraging... and it made me want to 
straighten my posture and stand tall."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"There's a girl overflowing with this much 
passion and dreams. I have to do my best 
too."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Since then, our debut in the same class 
was decided... and we started running 
toward our dream together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—However, for now... I can only stare at 
your back.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Back at the 'NHK Mile Cup,' your run 
was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To carve out a new future for the Tiara. 
Just as she said—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It makes one feel possibilities. Dreams. 
Hope. ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It was a race truly worthy of being 
described as "carving out a new era in 
history."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: History...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(If I recall, Cesario always said... She 
wanted to become the foundation... for the 
history the Tiara route has woven—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft. You've truly become... a 
radiant presence.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...So much so that it stirs feelings of 
longing within me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, that is precisely why! ...That is 
why I refuse to fall behind either.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I could talk all night with none other 
than you. My feelings and dreams for the 
Tiara route... ...I, too, continue to hold 
them fiercely in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As you know... no Japanese horse girl has 
ever won an American G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I will go. That is 
precisely why I will fulfill it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I shall claim victory. I, who walk the 
Tiara route! And then—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The glorious history of the Tiara route... 
This time, I will color it vividly with my 
own hands...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Cesario—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Craft. ...For now, I am still looking at 
your back."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I won't let you get away. Racing 
from behind happens to be my forte."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I will draw level and overtake them. I 
swear it."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—As comrades who yearn for the Tiara, and 
live for the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah, understood. ...Then I'll watch too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Your races, too. ...Along with the new 
future of the Tiara path that you'll show 
us.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching with anticipation. 
...Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just watch me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —I'll make you fall in love.
